drawing.frame_note: Left outline/corners are clipped; no missing corner is invented or used to normalize. Right corners are diagnostic only; the independent mechanism controls establish the affine fit.

drawing.method: Visually read each numbered insert center from the retained drawing crop, not from the VPX insert lights. Coordinates are projections of the lamp onto its printed insert center; the drawing does not expose the socket below the playfield. Six independently read bumper-ring centers/flipper pivots reconcile the page with the exact table. tools/drawing_callouts.py least-squares affine fit; positions rounded to 0.001 to match drawing precision. All remain observed, including measurements outside the convex hull of controls. This is not a socket survey.

world_mesh.algorithm: For each selected OBJ object, bound all emitted world-space v vertices per coordinate and take componentwise midpoint. Preserve all x/y in VPU; OBJ z has opposite sign to VPX z. No part identity inferred from bounds.
world_mesh.conclusion: Every dome-base x/y origin is within 0.001 normalized of its own world-space bounds midpoint. Four independent Bumper centers agree with the respective bumperbulb midpoint within 0.000001 normalized. Retain shared-helper stored origins as observed dome anchors; this checks coordinate origin, not factory measurement or independent physical validation.
